title: Census of AI / Frontier-Model Partnerships across the 2026 Formula 1 Grid
description: A hand-built, primary-source census of publicly disclosed artificial-intelligence, cloud, data, semiconductor, cybersecurity and enterprise-software partnerships held by the eleven 2026 Formula 1 teams (plus the driver-personal and F1-central landscape). Each of the 105 arrangements is coded for whether the FIA cost cap's valuation machinery can price it (a two-tier scheme built on three economic properties: bidirectional value flow, no clearing price, capability drift), for integration depth, activity class, and disclosure of financial terms, with an individually verified primary-source URL per record. The README is the full codebook, including the explicit inclusion rule, the coding rulebook, correction history, completeness caveat, and per-record source-verification log. Companion dataset to a study of frontier AI and spending-based competitive regulation.
